_comment: Declarative zone model. 'home' is the owner (user 0) and is NEVER created.

profiles.label: Home
profiles.vpn_note: Tailscale is not a full tunnel - lockdown would break LAN access and split routing.

profiles.label: Work
profiles.vpn_note: Own VPN slot for the work profile - independent of Tailscale in Home's personal area. Tested on the emulator 2026-09-15.
profiles.unlock: inherits the lock from Home, optional separate work challenge
profiles.notes: Managed profile under Home instead of a secondary user. Reason: only work profiles allow cross-profile contact resolution at ring time (InCallController.java branches on isManagedProfile) - so customer calls show names without company contacts being copied into Home. Isolates more weakly than a secondary user (runs alongside, the framework deliberately opens channels) - acceptable for apps the company entrusts with all its data anyway. UNTESTED: whether Intune MAM works inside it needs real hardware with sandboxed Play.

profiles.label: Cloud
profiles.vpn_note: lockdown optional: blocks everything outside the filter, can break captive portals.

profiles.label: Gadgets
profiles.vpn_note: lockdown ON: the IoT zone should not be able to bypass the filter.

profiles.label: Ops
profiles.vpn_note: Business tailnet, not a full tunnel.

profiles.label: Lab
profiles.vpn_note: deliberately empty - VPN depends on the test case, 35-vpn.sh skips this profile.

profiles.label: Anon
profiles.vpn_note: lockdown MANDATORY: without it, traffic bypasses Tor, silently.
